Why does your tea dribble down the side of the cup instead of pouring cleanly into the glass? In this video, we explain the "teapot effect" in simple words — the tug-of-war between adhesion and cohesion, why slow pours cling to the container, how pouring speed and angle decide where the liquid goes, and why a sharp-edged spout gives a clean pour.
Whether you're a student learning about surface tension, a curious mind who's tired of wiping up spills, or just someone who loves everyday physics, this explainer shows the hidden science behind a very ordinary mess.
